title: FOURTH LEVEL SPELLS - the 20 fourth level shukenja spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and sohei codes
audit_label: R662 OA fourth level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round forty-nine (capture pp. 132-140): the fourth level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and sohei-usable markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: FOURTH LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 132-140 - the OA fourth level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read - the 20 fourth level spell stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes (print pp. 132-140; compressed pp. 66-69); all 20 schools, component sets, casting times and saving throws agree, zero contested stat reads. Three component singles dot the level: polymorph self takes the verbal only, endurance the somatic and material, reward the verbal and material - all three read identically in the two passes. Two new encodings debut: the exorcise cast is variable (1-100+ turns, the only unfixed cast in the chapter) and pins as -1, and the snake barrier save reads 1/2 - the print garbling it as 112, the compressed reading it clean - pinning as the new half code 3. Fate takes the longest fixed cast at six turns. Alteration is the most common school at seven spells; abjure's dual school abjuration/conjuration pins as the primary abjuration. The reversible flags agree between the passes; the sohei-usable marks ride the R658 T62 grid. The stat grid pins as a table: 20 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60, 6 turns = 360, -1 the variable cast), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special, 3 half), reversible and sohei markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions and the Table 65 fate grid close in their own rounds. The table tag L4Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
